title: Senior Software Engineer
jobDescription:
Senior Software Engineer

Location: Hybrid, Pune

Position Summary:

The successful candidate will be responsible for developing, enhancing, and maintaining modern web applications for the Bentley Infrastructure Cloud product line. This role requires strong hands-on expertise in React based frontend development, cloud native solutions on Microsoft Azure, and CI/CD practices using Azure Dev Ops. The position offers the opportunity to work on cutting edge technologies, collaborate with global, cross functional teams, and deliver high quality, user centric solutions that support Bentley’s infrastructure and engineering products.

  • Leverage Azure and Azure Dev Ops for CI/CD pipelines, builds, deployments, and operational readiness, contributing to performance optimization, scalability considerations, and agile delivery practices.

  • Bachelor’s or Master's degree in computer science or engineering, with a strong foundation in software engineering and frontend web development.

title: Manager, Site Reliability Engineering

SRE Managers operate with significant autonomy and are accountable for the operational success of an entire service area, product platform, or collection of services. They are trusted to make decisions that affect multiple teams and are expected to build systems, processes, and organizations that scale.

Reliability Leadership

  • Own availability, performance, scalability, and operational health of assigned services.
  • Drive adoption and enforcement of SRE practices including SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, incident management, and operational reviews.
  • Own reliability roadmaps and ensure investment is balanced between feature delivery, technical debt reduction, and operational sustainability.
  • Establish measurable operational targets and continuously improve system resilience.

Strategic Execution & Organizational Leadership
